title: New ransomware campaign targeting cloud infrastructure
description: Security researchers have identified a new ransomware variant specifically designed to target cloud-based infrastructure. The campaign uses compromised CI/CD pipelines to deploy malicious code.

title: Show HN: Open-source vulnerability scanner
description: New tool automatically scans dependencies for known vulnerabilities and suggests patches. Gaining traction in the security community.

title: A flaw has been found in DataLinkDC Dinky up to 1.2.5. Impacted is the function file...
description: A flaw has been found in DataLinkDC Dinky up to 1.2.5. Impacted is the function file.getOriginalFilename of the file CatalogueController.java of the component Catalogue Upload. Executing a manipulation of the argument filename can lead to path traversal. The attack can be executed remotely. The exploit has been published and may be used. The researcher claims to have submitted a GHSA on the repository of the project.

title: The Event Tickets Manager for WooCommerce WordPress plugin before 1.6.0 does not perform...
description: The Event Tickets Manager for WooCommerce WordPress plugin before 1.6.0 does not perform authorisation or a valid nonce check on its ticket-transfer feature, which is available to unauthenticated users, allowing them to transfer other attendees' guest-checkout tickets to an email address of their choosing, invalidating the legitimate ticket and causing the victim's ticket PDF, which contains attendee personal data, to be sent to the attacker.

title: The Pie Register  WordPress plugin through 3.8.4.15 does not perform an authorisation check in...
description: The Pie Register  WordPress plugin through 3.8.4.15 does not perform an authorisation check in one of its AJAX actions, allowing users with a role as low as contributor to modify existing administrator-created invitation-code records.

title: The Secure Custom Fields WordPress plugin before 6.9.8 does not perform a read-permission check...
description: The Secure Custom Fields WordPress plugin before 6.9.8 does not perform a read-permission check when it renders and formats the values of its relational fields, allowing users with post-editing access (Contributor and above) to disclose the titles and non-public statuses of other users' unpublished posts.

title: The Secure Custom Fields WordPress plugin before 6.9.8 does not verify that a user is allowed to...
description: The Secure Custom Fields WordPress plugin before 6.9.8 does not verify that a user is allowed to edit the target object before writing to it during bidirectional relationship synchronization, allowing users with contributor-level access and above to add or remove a reference to their own object on arbitrary posts, users, or terms they cannot otherwise edit.

title: The Secure Custom Fields WordPress plugin before 6.9.8 does not sanitize a persisted field...
description: The Secure Custom Fields WordPress plugin before 6.9.8 does not sanitize a persisted field definition before emitting part of it as an HTML attribute name, allowing a user able to configure its fields to store a payload that executes as JavaScript in the browser of any user who views a page rendering the affected field, which on multisite lets a site administrator who lacks the unfiltered_html capability inject script into other users' sessions.

title: The Pie Register  WordPress plugin through 3.8.4.15 does not perform any capability, nonce or...
description: The Pie Register  WordPress plugin through 3.8.4.15 does not perform any capability, nonce or authentication check on one of its request handlers, allowing unauthenticated attackers to reset the Pie Register  WordPress plugin through 3.8.4.15's settings to their defaults (disabling registration security controls such as new-user email verification) and to destroy a Pie Register  WordPress plugin through 3.8.4.15 data table.

title: The Secure Custom Fields WordPress plugin before 6.9.8 does not re-apply its field-group location...
description: The Secure Custom Fields WordPress plugin before 6.9.8 does not re-apply its field-group location rules when persisting values submitted through the post editor save path, allowing users with contributor-level access and above to write custom fields the site restricted to administrators onto their own posts.

title: The FV Flowplayer Video Player WordPress plugin before 7.5.57.7212 does not perform any...
description: The FV Flowplayer Video Player WordPress plugin before 7.5.57.7212 does not perform any authorization check on an AJAX action that carries out a site-wide content rewrite, so any authenticated user, including subscriber-level, can trigger a bulk modification of posts they should not be able to edit.

title: The Userplace  WordPress plugin through 1.2.0 does not perform authorization checks on an AJAX...
description: The Userplace  WordPress plugin through 1.2.0 does not perform authorization checks on an AJAX action available to unauthenticated users and publicly exposes the nonce that protects it, allowing unauthenticated attackers to create an administrator account or write arbitrary site options, leading to full site takeover.

title: The Thanh Toán Quét Mã QR Code Tự Động  WordPress plugin through 2.0.1 does not properly verify...
description: The Thanh Toán Quét Mã QR Code Tự Động  WordPress plugin through 2.0.1 does not properly verify the authenticity of incoming bank-transfer payment notifications on a default installation, allowing unauthenticated attackers to mark arbitrary WooCommerce orders as paid.

title: The Pronamic Pay WordPress plugin before 11.1.0, Pronamic Pay doneren met Mollie WordPress plugin...
description: The Pronamic Pay WordPress plugin before 11.1.0, Pronamic Pay doneren met Mollie WordPress plugin before 1.7.1 do not restrict access to stored form submissions through the REST API, allowing unauthenticated users to read the messages that visitors submitted through the bundled forms.

title: The Sync Post With Other Site WordPress plugin before 1.9.4 does not properly authorize a content...
description: The Sync Post With Other Site WordPress plugin before 1.9.4 does not properly authorize a content-management action for post types other than pages, allowing users with Contributor-level access or above to create and modify arbitrary custom post types, including reassigning content authorship.

title: The Razorpay for WooCommerce WordPress plugin before 4.8.9 does not sanitize and escape a value...
description: The Razorpay for WooCommerce WordPress plugin before 4.8.9 does not sanitize and escape a value derived from an incoming webhook request before using it in a SQL query, allowing users able to obtain the webhook secret (administrators) to perform SQL injection attacks.

title: The Ecommerce Affiliate WordPress plugin through 1.0.0 does not restrict one-time password...
description: The Ecommerce Affiliate WordPress plugin through 1.0.0 does not restrict one-time password issuance and verification to the legitimate account owner, nor limit verification attempts, allowing unauthenticated attackers to take over any account, including administrators.

title: The WP Recipe Maker WordPress plugin before 10.9.2 does not check whether the post a recipe is...
description: The WP Recipe Maker WordPress plugin before 10.9.2 does not check whether the post a recipe is embedded in is password protected before returning the recipe through its REST API and structured data output, allowing unauthenticated users to read the full content of recipes in password-protected posts.

title: The Contact Form 7 WordPress plugin before 6.2.4 does not validate the type or extension of files...
description: The Contact Form 7 WordPress plugin before 6.2.4 does not validate the type or extension of files uploaded through a form file field, and a flaw in its temporary-file cleanup leaves the uploaded file on disk, allowing unauthenticated users to upload arbitrary files to the site. On a stock Debian or Ubuntu Apache configuration, which lists directory contents and maps .phar to the PHP handler, the stored file can be located and executed, leading to Remote Code Execution. title: The Productive Commerce  WordPress plugin before 1.1.54 does not sanitise and escape a parameter...
description: The Productive Commerce  WordPress plugin before 1.1.54 does not sanitise and escape a parameter before using it in a SQL statement, allowing unauthenticated attackers to perform SQL injection attacks.

title: CVE-2026-120192 - A security vulnerability has been detected in Presenton up to 0.9.11-beta. This affects an unknown p
description: A security vulnerability has been detected in Presenton up to 0.9.11-beta. This affects an unknown part of the file /app_data of the component Desktop Authentication Middleware. Such manipulation leads to information disclosure. It is possible to launch the attack remotely. The exploit has been disclosed publicly and may be used. Upgrading to version 0.9.12-beta is able to mitigate this issue. The name of the patch is 44c8a61122b21f17642d717b0c4d6f2c54c0f180. The affected component should be upgraded.

title: CVE-2026-120252 - imagecodecs 2023.1.23 through 2026.10.10 contains a stack-based buffer overflow vulnerability in the
description: imagecodecs 2023.1.23 through 2026.10.10 contains a stack-based buffer overflow vulnerability in the lossless JPEG Define Huffman Table parser in decode_jpegsof3(). Attackers can supply a crafted lossless JPEG whose DHT symbol counts wrap an 8-bit sum, overflowing the 32-entry HufVal and HufSz stack arrays and crashing the calling process.

title: CVE-2026-120251 - imagecodecs 2026.3.6 through 2026.10.10 contains an infinite loop vulnerability in ccitt_fax4_decode
description: imagecodecs 2026.3.6 through 2026.10.10 contains an infinite loop vulnerability in ccitt_fax4_decode_size() that allows attackers to hang the calling process by supplying a crafted CCITT Group 4 stream. Attackers can provide an 8-byte G4 stream lacking EOFB to ccittfax4_decode() or the numcodecs Ccittfax4 codec, consuming full CPU until the process is killed.

title: CVE-2026-120250 - OpenAlgo 1.0.0.29 before 2.0.3.1 contains an improper certificate validation vulnerability in utils/
description: OpenAlgo 1.0.0.29 before 2.0.3.1 contains an improper certificate validation vulnerability in utils/email_utils.py and utils/email_debug.py that disables TLS hostname and certificate checks for STARTTLS and SMTPS. Network-positioned attackers can present a forged certificate to intercept SMTP credentials and all later mail, including password-reset links.

title: CVE-2026-120249 - Thelia Back-office Default Twig Template before 1.1.1 contains a cross-site request forgery vulnerab
description: Thelia Back-office Default Twig Template before 1.1.1 contains a cross-site request forgery vulnerability in the /admin/product/combinations/update and /admin/product/default-price/update routes, which accept GET requests without anti-CSRF token checks. Attackers can lure a logged-in administrator into following a crafted link to rewrite product combination prices, stock, weight, EAN and sale flags, zeroing omitted prices.

title: CVE-2026-120248 - Thelia before 3.1.1 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows authenticated b
description: Thelia before 3.1.1 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows authenticated back-office administrators with store update permission to inject scripts by uploading unsanitized SVG logo_file or banner_file images. Attackers can upload an SVG with an onload payload served from /admin/store-media/logo or the public cache/images/store/ directory to execute scripts against visitors and higher-privileged administrators.

title: CVE-2026-120247 - FFmpeg 2.3 through 9.0.2 contains a use of uninitialized resource vulnerability in the Huffyuv decod
description: FFmpeg 2.3 through 9.0.2 contains a use of uninitialized resource vulnerability in the Huffyuv decoder that allows attackers to leak heap memory into decoded pixels via short packed-BGR bitstreams. Attackers can craft a Huffyuv BGR24/BGRA video whose entropy data ends early, causing decode_slice() to add uninitialized s->temp[0] bytes into output frames, exposing heap contents.

title: CVE-2026-120246 - FFmpeg 4.4 through 9.0.2 contains a use of uninitialized variable vulnerability in the CDXL decoder
description: FFmpeg 4.4 through 9.0.2 contains a use of uninitialized variable vulnerability in the CDXL decoder that leaks stack memory into decoded pixels via unfilled HAM palette entries. Attackers can craft a type-0 CDXL file whose HAM pixels select unfilled new_palette entries in cdxl_decode_ham8() or cdxl_decode_ham6(), exposing stack bytes and pointer fragments in the BGR24 output.

title: CVE-2026-120245 - FFmpeg 0.10 through 9.0.2 contains a use of uninitialized resource vulnerability in sunrast_decode_f
description: FFmpeg 0.10 through 9.0.2 contains a use of uninitialized resource vulnerability in sunrast_decode_frame() that leaks heap memory when decoding truncated 1-bit and 4-bit paletted Sun Raster images. Attackers can craft a truncated Sun Raster file so the uncleared temporary bitmap is expanded into PAL8 pixels, exposing stale heap contents such as allocator words in decoded output.

title: CVE-2026-120244 - FFmpeg 2.1 through 9.0.2 contains a use of uninitialized resource vulnerability in the PCX decoder t
description: FFmpeg 2.1 through 9.0.2 contains a use of uninitialized resource vulnerability in the PCX decoder that allows attackers to leak heap memory through truncated RLE scanlines. Attackers can craft a PCX image whose RLE data ends early, causing pcx_decode_frame() to copy uninitialized av_malloc() buffer contents into visible decoded pixels.

title: CVE-2026-120243 - FFmpeg 2.0 through 9.0.2 contains a use of uninitialized variable vulnerability in the Go2Meeting de
description: FFmpeg 2.0 through 9.0.2 contains a use of uninitialized variable vulnerability in the Go2Meeting decoder that allows attackers to leak stack memory through out-of-range palette indices. Attackers can craft a G2M3/G2M4 stream with a short Kempf palette so kempf_restore_buf() copies uninitialized stack bytes, including pointers or stack guards, into decoded output.

title: CVE-2026-120191 - A weakness has been identified in Presenton up to 0.9.11-beta. Affected by this issue is some unknow
description: A weakness has been identified in Presenton up to 0.9.11-beta. Affected by this issue is some unknown functionality of the component API. This manipulation causes missing authentication. It is possible to initiate the attack remotely. The exploit has been made available to the public and could be used for attacks. Upgrading to version 0.9.12-beta can resolve this issue. title: CVE-2026-120190 - A security flaw has been discovered in PostyBirb Plus up to 3.1.75. Affected by this vulnerability i
description: A security flaw has been discovered in PostyBirb Plus up to 3.1.75. Affected by this vulnerability is an unknown functionality of the file ui/src/views/submissions/submission-forms/form-components/DescriptionInput.tsx of the component Submission Description Editor. The manipulation results in cross site scripting. The attack may be performed from remote. The exploit has been released to the public and may be used for attacks. Upgrading to version 3.1.76 addresses this issue. The patch is identified as 6b11c2345ad98ae59fd5404a9f1024eb1d10c8a4. It is advisable to upgrade the affected component.

title: CVE-2026-120189 - A vulnerability was identified in D-Link DIR-505 1.10B02. Affected is the function save_upload_file/
description: A vulnerability was identified in D-Link DIR-505 1.10B02. Affected is the function save_upload_file/mp_upload_file of the file /usr/bin/tftpd of the component TFTP Upload Filename Handler. The manipulation leads to stack-based buffer overflow. The attack is possible to be carried out remotely. The exploit is publicly available and might be used.

title: CVE-2026-115946 - XS::libbrotli versions before 1.2.1.0 for Perl bundle a brotli library with an out-of-bounds write i
description:
XS::libbrotli versions before 1.2.1.0 for Perl bundle a brotli library with an out-of-bounds write in the decoder.

Affected versions compile a bundled brotli into static archives that dependent XS modules link against at build time, rather than using the system library. The bundled copy, 1.0.7 or 1.1.0 across the range, carries the decoder out-of-bounds write described in CVE-2026-111497. Version 1.2.1.0 updates it to brotli 1.2.1.

XS::libbrotli has no Perl interface, so the decoder is reached through any dependent module that decompresses untrusted data with it. An attacker supplying a crafted brotli stream can corrupt decoder state, disclose memory, crash the process, or potentially execute arbitrary code. Upgrading the system brotli does not remediate this.
